Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-006 (Buying and Merchandising-1) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Supermarket features, branding, four pricing methods, budget planning, sales forecasting, vendor selection
  • Trade and quantity discount, merchandise and assortment planning, national and private label brands, key performance indicators

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-006/TMA/2026-27. Part A: short type questions of 10 marks each (as printed). Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each
  • Question 7 carries 5+5 marks, as printed

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
